editorial.best_time: Saturday or Sunday, when market hours run to 4 p.m.

facts.claim: Friday hours are 8 a.m. to 3 p.m.
Saturday hours are 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.
Sunday hours are 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.
The Market of Marion is in Belleview, FL 34491.

evidence.source_name: Farlow's on the Water — official source
supports: Farlow's On The Water is a waterfront restaurant in Englewood.
The official site lists Ahi Tuna, American Red Snapper, Black Grouper, Hogfish, Mahi and Yellowtail Snapper.
The official site lists lunch Monday to Saturday from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m.
The official site lists live entertainment Wednesday to Sunday.
The official site says food is made fresh daily.
